The '''Summit Farm Blossom Winery''' was a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] situated near the foothill of the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The house of the farm was a building made of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] and [[Stone/Legends|stone]], with a quaint-peaked roof. The farm was also comprised of several fields of cultivated [[Flower/Legends|flowers]] which varied in [[Color/Legends|color]], size and shape. They had a heady fragrance and were used to manufacture [[blossom wine]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade of Naboo]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was sent to the farm by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. It is there that Maul met and eventually killed [[Maris Magneta]], the head of security of the late [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Veruna]].
